common: Generate a seamless tileable square texture. Flat top-down orthographic view, zero perspective, no cast shadows, perfectly even flat lighting. Saturated candy colours, clean smooth vector-like shapes, playful toy aesthetic. The pattern repeats perfectly: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. No border, no frame, no vignette, no text, no logo, no watermark. The pattern fills the entire square edge to edge.
